gap: A register read while only some buildings of its map item were drafted is read again when more are drafted or a package is decided at a new revision, so a row keyed to a later building can match

built.queueIntakeEvidenceTx: optional cause ReadAgain = {rawJobId} | {anchorsSha256}; the job id ends ':raw:<rawJobId>' (ER1, unchanged) or ':anchors:<digest>' (G21); with no cause it is the earlier id exactly (tested). A reading has one cause, so the suffixes never combine. The job input keeps an optional anchorsSha256: the digest of the map item's buildings it was queued under
built.anchorsDigestTx: fingerprint of [{targetId, packageId, packageRevision}] of every target of the anchor item, ordered by target id; packageRevision is the package body's revision, as evidenceAnchorsTx reads it
built.queueAnchorEvidenceTx: intake-evidence.ts: finds the package's map item; locks the job rows of every coverage row of the profiles anchored on it FOR SHARE, then reads those coverage rows; skips a reading whose job is queued or whose input names the current digest; queues each other one with the anchors cause
built.declareIntakeKeyProfile: the first readings keep their ids and record the digest at declaration, so deciding the buildings they read queues nothing
built.queueFinishedTableEvidenceTx: ER1's reading read again keeps the replaced reading's digest (it reads no fewer buildings); its id is unchanged
built.calls: intake-targets.ts createIntakeTargetsTx (when a target row was inserted) and prepareIntakeTargetsTx (after the targets are decided)

decisions.D1: one reading per source read under each profile anchored on the item; a digest already read or queued is never queued twice: the job id check, plus the digest kept in the current reading's input
decisions.D2: a source whose coverage names a queued job is skipped: its claim waits on the job rows locked here and reads the new targets; a running reading is replaced through the existing coverage upsert and its write is refused 409 (tested); job rows are locked before coverage, as ER1
decisions.D3: nothing is deleted: the earlier job, result and candidates stay until the new reading writes; every earlier candidate comes back once under its stable id with its new outcome; stored confirmations are not touched
decisions.D4: a second footprint file (another anchor item) is out of scope: the officer declares a profile for it
decisions.D5: no table and no SQL migration: the digest lives in the job id and the job input

deviation.recordPackageTargetsTx: not called. The commit moves the package revision by one without changing a feature, and the citation step re-checks a stored evidence confirmation's reading and candidate pins after the commit (intake-evidence-citations.ts recheckTx). A reading queued at the commit would refuse every evidence confirmation made before it.
